clips.why: Curve e1000-e2500 (det, 8 envs): the book centre rises 6-12 cm from frame ~40, i.e. before the reference starts lifting at ~53 ('lead'), and its tilt goes to ~90 deg: it is stood on its long edge on the desk (centre 0.80 m) instead of lifted (reference 1.20 m at frame 80). Watch: which hand(s) pivot it, where the fingers are, and why it is not lifted off the desk (fingers under / around the book? one hand pushing it up against the other?).

e2000: 6/8 rollout episodes drop the book at frames 83-87 (as the reference starts the sideways walk); it hits the floor at 94-100 and the character falls at 103-120. Watch: does the hand open / the book rotate out of the pinch, or is the edge-standing book pushed off the desk when the body turns to walk?
